post.caption:
A banknote costs a few rupees to produce and is worth its face value because everyone behaves as though it is. Money went from being the commodity itself, to paper promising the commodity, to paper alone once the promise was dropped. What holds it up now is trust in the issuing institution plus legal tender status, and nothing else. Hyperinflation is the agreement breaking, not the paper changing.
